caption: The drawing shows a single, column-like candlestick holder with a broad, rectangular base. The candlestick holder is depicted in shades of yellow and gold, with some greenish-gray shadows and details to create the effect of depth and texture. The surface appears fluted with vertical grooves and the top edge is rounded. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, red line illustration showing the internal mechanism of the candlestick holder from a side angle and a square top-down view, labeled with the phrase "Showing 'Sliding Rod' attached to Disc for pushing candle up." The entire composition is set against a plain, uncolored background, and a small signature is present near the lower right side of the main drawing.
title: Candlestick
